CFB-week.summary: Ohio State plays at USC with true freshman Luke Fahey at QB after Julian Sayin's likely season-ending injury. Oregon is without Dante Moore for the rest of the season, and Dylan Raiola is posted as the QB against Northwestern. Iowa lost leading rusher Kamari Moulton for the season and starts Hank Brown at QB against Wisconsin.

NBA-CHA-at-WSH-1030.summary: Injury/rotation check only. Washington is without Justin Champagnie (foot, expected to miss several months) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip); Tre Johnson (Achilles) is questionable. Trae Young is not on the Wizards injury list.

NBA-LAL-at-GS-1031.summary: Luka Doncic is off the Lakers injury report after resting a back issue, and Ziaire Williams (left foot/heel) is questionable pending a pregame check. Golden State remains without Porzingis, Butler and Moody, with Gui Santos (knee) day-to-day.

NBA-ORL-at-TOR-1030.summary: Rematch two days after Toronto beat Orlando 129-99 in Toronto. Orlando is without Banchero, Suggs, Isaac and Penda and started Anthony Black over Tristan da Silva on Wednesday; Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee, weeks) and Nate Bittle.

NFL-ARI-at-DAL-1101.summary: Dallas is a 7-point home favorite indoors; George Pickens (shoulder plus a new hamstring issue) was limited all week and KaVontae Turpin (ribs) did not practice. Arizona's Jeremiyah Love returned from a two-game ankle absence but stayed limited, Tyler Allgeier (toe) and Michael Wilson (ribs) were limited, and DL Walter Nolen III and RG Jon Gaines II missed both practices.

NFL-ATL-at-TB-1101.summary: Tampa Bay's offense is mostly intact: Baker Mayfield (thumb) practiced fully, and Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) was limited Wednesday and Thursday, moved to a regular jersey Thursday, but still needs independent neurologist clearance. RT Luke Goedeke (calf) missed both days and RB Kenny Gainwell (hip) went DNP then limited. Atlanta backup RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) missed Wednesday and Thursday, keeping the backfield on Bijan Robinson.

NFL-BAL-at-BUF-1101.summary: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practiced fully Wednesday and Thursday and is trending toward returning after missing three games, during which Baltimore went 1-2 and was shut out after halftime in its last two losses. Buffalo comes off a bye with DJ Moore (shoulder) and Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited, RT Spencer Brown (back) out of practice both days, and backup RB Ray Davis sick Thursday.

NFL-CLE-at-PIT-1101.summary: Pittsburgh leaned on a Warren-Dowdle backfield and a jumbo package in its last game while defenses shaded coverage to Metcalf, with the backs absorbing short targets. Cleveland's line is banged up (C Elgton Jenkins and OT Tytus Howard missed Wednesday) and several Browns defenders, including Verse, Delpit and Thomas, are on the report. Friday final designations were not yet posted.

NFL-IND-at-JAX-1101.summary: Indianapolis' passing game is thin: TE Tyler Warren (groin) has missed two straight games and was limited Thursday, Alec Pierce is on IR, and CB Justin Walley (knee) did not practice, though Sauce Gardner returned to full practice. Jacksonville's Jakobi Meyers (hamstring) and RB LeQuint Allen (hamstring) were limited, and the forecast calls for wind around 15 mph with gusts near 20 and a 40% chance of rain.

NFL-KC-at-DEN-1101.summary: Kansas City's pass catchers are uncertain: Travis Kelce (ankle) went from full Wednesday to limited Thursday and Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited again. Patrick Mahomes (knee) practiced fully both days. Kenneth Walker's receptions line has fallen from 3.5 to 2.5 with no explaining news found. Denver WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) and RB RJ Harvey (knee) were limited.

NFL-LV-at-NYJ-1101.summary: Breece Hall (quad) is trying to return after four missed games but was limited all week; Braelon Allen, who has produced as the starter, practiced fully Thursday. For Las Vegas, Brock Bowers (calf) went from limited to full, while G Jackson Powers-Johnson (back) missed Thursday.

NFL-MIN-at-DET-1101.summary: Minnesota RB Aaron Jones (knee) missed Wednesday and was limited Thursday, and is day-to-day; Jordan Mason led the backfield with 15 carries in Week 7. Backup TE Gavin Bartholomew (ankle) was added to the report Thursday and did not practice. Detroit's Jahmyr Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown practiced fully Thursday; S Kerby Joseph and CB Ennis Rakestraw were limited both days.

NFL-NE-at-MIA-1101.summary: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and TreVeyon Henderson (illness) did not practice Thursday, so New England's WR1 and RB2 are uncertain. Miami's Malik Willis practiced fully (groin) but TE Greg Dulcich, WR Malik Washington and long snapper Tucker Addington were limited all week; New England's secondary is expected to have its starting corners and safeties together for the first time since Week 1.

NFL-TEN-at-CIN-1101.summary: Tennessee's top two receivers are banged up: rookie WR1 Carnell Tate (shoulder) missed Wednesday and Thursday practice and Calvin Ridley (hip) was limited both days, which clouds Cam Ward's passing outlook. Backup RB Tyjae Spears (knee) also missed both days, leaving Tony Pollard as the clear lead back. Cincinnati's skill players are healthy; Ja'Marr Chase's Wednesday absence was rest and he was full Thursday.

SOCCER-day.summary: No one confirmed out. Brobbey (hamstring, listed 75% and left out of predicted XI) and Zaroury (left his last match with an ankle issue) are flagged caution; Becker, Mwene, Thauvin, Mukiele, Camello and Guirassy appear in predicted XIs.

fix.summary: Eagles lost Jalen Hurts for the season (blood clots), so Jake Elliott's under gets support. Ohio State plays at USC without QB Julian Sayin and RB Ja'Kobi Jackson. Oregon is still without QB Dante Moore. Kyren Williams split carries almost evenly with Blake Corum last week.

NBA-SAC-at-NO-1030.summary: New Orleans (0-4) plays the second night of a back-to-back after losing at home to Denver on Oct 28; Jordan Poole left that game with a left ankle injury and is day-to-day. Sacramento remains without Keegan Murray, Ben Simmons and backup centers Raynaud and Cardwell, so Sabonis and Achiuwa carry the frontcourt; no new changes to either team's starters were found.

NFL-CAR-at-GB-1030.summary: Josh Jacobs came back from the exempt list last week, played about half the snaps and took both goal-line snaps, so MarShawn Lloyd is now the backup. Carolina's offensive line is badly thinned: both starting guards are out, Moton is on IR and a rookie starts at right tackle. Green Bay is without Parsons, Franklin, guard Rhyan and tackle Glover, and Matthew Golden is questionable but was upgraded to limited practice Wednesday.
